name: hardware-projects
install: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24.15.0; nvm alias default 24.15.0; corepack enable; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile'

terminals.name: cappy-messages
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24.15.0 > /dev/null; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/v24.15.0/bin:$PATH"; pnpm --filter cappy-messages dev'
